title: Multivariate Distributional Reinforcement Learning Using Sliced Divergences
abstract: arXiv:2605.31222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution rather than expectations, but extending it to multivariate settings remains challenging. Many common metrics do not naturally generalize beyond one dimension or lose computational tractability, and the multivariate case introduces additional difficulties such as general matrix discounting, for which no contraction results are available. We introduce Sliced Distributional Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which lifts tractable one-dimensional divergences to multivariate return distributions via projections. We prove Bellman contraction for uniform slicing under shared scalar discounting, and introduce a maximum-slicing variant with contraction under general dense discount matrices. translated_title: 基于切片散度的多元分布强化学习
translated_abstract: 分布强化学习（DRL）对完整的回报分布进行建模，而不仅仅是对期望建模，但将其扩展到多元情形仍然具有挑战性。许多常见的度量无法自然地推广到一维之外，或者会失去计算上的可行性，并且多元情形还引入了额外的困难，例如一般矩阵折扣，对此尚无压缩性结果可用。我们提出了切片分布强化学习（SDRL），它通过投影将易于处理的一维散度提升到多元回报分布上。我们证明了在共享标量折扣下均匀切片的贝尔曼压缩性，并引入了一种在一般稠密折扣矩阵下具有压缩性的最大切片变体。SDRL 支持一大类基础散度；我们分析了 Wasserstein 散度、Cramér 散度和最大均值差异（MMD），并刻画了哪些 SDRL 变体适合标准的单……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出切片分布强化学习（SDRL），通过投影将易于处理的一维散度推广到多元回报分布，并证明了均匀切片和最大切片变体分别在标量折扣和一般矩阵折扣下的贝尔曼压缩性，同时支持 Wasserstein、Cramér 和 MMD 等多种基础散度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Sliced Distributional Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which lifts tractable one-dimensional divergences to multivariate return distributions via projections, proves Bellman contraction for uniform slicing under shared scalar discounting and for a maximum-slicing variant under general dense discount matrices, and supports a broad class of base divergences including Wasserstein, Cramér, and MMD.
